    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Live API capabilities guide<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p>
</p>

<p>
</p>































<aside class="preview"><strong>Preview:</strong><span> The Live API is in preview.</span></aside>
<p>This is a comprehensive guide that covers capabilities and configurations
available with the Live API.
See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/live">Get started with Live API</a> page for an
overview and sample code for common use cases.</p>

<h2 id="before-you-begin" class="hide-from-toc" data-text="Before you begin" tabindex="-1">Before you begin</h2>

<ul>
<li><strong>Familiarize yourself with core concepts:</strong> If you haven&#39;t already done so,
read the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/live">Get started with Live API </a> page first.
This will introduce you to the fundamental principles of the Live API, how it
works, and the different <a href="/gemini-api/docs/live#implementation-approach">implementation approaches</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Try the Live API in AI Studio:</strong> You may find it useful to try the
Live API in <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/app/live">Google AI Studio</a> before you start building. To use the
Live API in Google AI Studio, select <strong>Stream</strong>.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="model-comparison" data-text="Model comparison" tabindex="-1">Model comparison</h2>

<p>The following table summarizes the key differences between the
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview">Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview</a> and the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025">Gemini 2.5 Flash Live Preview</a> models:</p>

<table class="pricing-table" style="width: 100%; table-layout: fixed;">
  <colgroup>
    <col class="paid-tier" width="20%">
    <col width="40%">
    <col class="paid-tier" width="40%">
  </colgroup>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Feature</th>
      <th scope="col">Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Preview</th>
      <th scope="col">Gemini 2.5 Flash Live Preview</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#native-audio-output-thinking">Thinking</a></b></td>
      <td>Uses <code translate="no" dir="ltr">thinkingLevel</code> to control thinking depth with settings like <code translate="no" dir="ltr">minimal</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">low</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">medium</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">high</code>. Defaults to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">minimal</code> to optimize for lowest latency. See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/thinking#levels-budgets">Thinking levels and budgets</a>.</td>
      <td>Uses <code translate="no" dir="ltr">thinkingBudget</code> to set the number of thinking tokens. Dynamic thinking is enabled by default. Set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">thinkingBudget</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">0</code> to disable. See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/thinking#levels-budgets">Thinking levels and budgets</a>.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="/api/live#bidigeneratecontentservercontent">Receiving response</a></b></td>
      <td>A single server event can contain multiple content parts simultaneously (for example, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">inlineData</code> and transcript). Ensure your code processes all parts in each event to avoid missing content.</td>
      <td>Each server event contains only one content part. Parts are delivered in separate events.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#incremental-updates">Client content</a></b></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_client_content</code> is only supported for seeding initial context history (requires setting <code translate="no" dir="ltr">initial_history_in_client_content</code> in session config). To send text updates during the conversation, use <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_realtime_input</code> instead.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_client_content</code> is supported throughout the conversation for sending incremental content updates and establishing context.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="/api/live#turncoverage">Turn coverage</a></b></td>
      <td>Defaults to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_AUDIO_ACTIVITY_AND_ALL_VIDEO</code>. The model's turn includes detected audio activity and all video frames.</td>
      <td>Defaults to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">TURN_INCLUDES_ONLY_ACTIVITY</code>. The model's turn includes only the detected activity.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#disable-automatic-vad">Custom VAD</a></b> (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">activity_start</code>/<code translate="no" dir="ltr">activity_end</code>)</td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. Disable automatic VAD and send <code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityStart</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityEnd</code> messages manually to control turn boundaries.</td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. Disable automatic VAD and send <code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityStart</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityEnd</code> messages manually to control turn boundaries.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#configure-automatic-vad">Automatic VAD configuration</a></b></td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. Configure parameters such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">start_of_speech_sensitivity</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">end_of_speech_sensitivity</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">prefix_padding_ms</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">silence_duration_ms</code>.</td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. Configure parameters such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">start_of_speech_sensitivity</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">end_of_speech_sensitivity</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">prefix_padding_ms</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">silence_duration_ms</code>.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="/gemini-api/docs/live-tools#async-function-calling">Asynchronous function calling</a></b> (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">behavior: NON_BLOCKING</code>)</td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-not-supported">Not supported</span>. Function calling is sequential only. The model will not start responding until you've sent the tool response.</td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. Set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">behavior</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">NON_BLOCKING</code> on a function declaration to let the model continue interacting while the function runs. Control how the model handles responses with the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">scheduling</code> parameter (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">INTERRUPT</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">WHEN_IDLE</code>, or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">SILENT</code>).</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#proactive-audio">Proactive audio</a></b></td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-not-supported">Not supported</span></td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. When enabled, the model can proactively decide not to respond if the input content is not relevant. Set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">proactive_audio</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code> in the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">proactivity</code> config (requires <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1beta</code>).</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><b><a href="#affective-dialog">Affective dialogue</a></b></td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-not-supported">Not supported</span></td>
      <td><span class="gemini-api-supported">Supported</span>. The model adapts its response style to match the expression and tone of the input. Set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">enable_affective_dialog</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code> in session config (requires <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1beta</code>).</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<p>To migrate from Gemini 2.5 Flash Live to Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, see the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview#migrating">migration guide</a>.</p>

<h2 id="establish-connection" data-text="Establishing a connection" tabindex="-1">Establishing a connection</h2>

<p>The following example shows how to create a connection with an API key:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">asyncio</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"response_modalities"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">def</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nf">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Session started"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send content...</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-vm">__name__</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"__main__"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">asyncio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">run</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">())</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Modality</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'@google/genai'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({});</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">responseModalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Modality</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">AUDIO</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">};</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">callbacks</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">onopen</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Opened'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">onmessage</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">message</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">message</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">onerror</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Error:'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">message</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">onclose</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Close:'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">reason</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Session started"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Send content...</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">close</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="modalities" data-text="Interaction modalities" tabindex="-1">Interaction modalities</h2>

<p>The following sections provide examples and supporting context for the different
input and output modalities available in Live API.</p>

<h3 id="send-receive-audio" data-text="Sending audio" tabindex="-1">Sending audio</h3>

<p>Audio needs to be sent as raw PCM data (raw 16-bit PCM audio, 16kHz, little-endian).</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_1" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Assuming 'chunk' is your raw PCM audio bytes</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Blob</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">chunk</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">mime_type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"audio/pcm;rate=16000"</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_1" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Assuming 'chunk' is a Buffer of raw PCM audio</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">sendRealtimeInput</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">audio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">chunk</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">toString</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'base64'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">),</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">mimeType</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'audio/pcm;rate=16000'</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="audio-formats" data-text="Audio formats" tabindex="-1">Audio formats</h3>

<p>Audio data in the Live API is always raw, little-endian,
16-bit PCM. Audio output always uses a sample rate of 24kHz. Input audio
is natively 16kHz, but the Live API will resample if needed
so any sample rate can be sent. To convey the sample rate of input audio, set
the MIME type of each audio-containing <a href="/api/caching#Blob">Blob</a> to a value
like <code translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/pcm;rate=16000</code>.</p>

<h3 id="receive-audio" data-text="Receiving audio" tabindex="-1">Receiving audio</h3>

<p>The model&#39;s audio responses are received as chunks of data.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_2" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">receive</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">server_content</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">and</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">server_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model_turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">part</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">server_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model_turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">parts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">part</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">inline_data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio_data</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">part</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">inline_data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">data</span>
                <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Process or play the audio data</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_2" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Inside the onmessage callback</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">?</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">modelTurn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">?</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">parts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">part</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">of</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">modelTurn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">parts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">part</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">inlineData</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">audioData</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">part</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">inlineData</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Process or play audioData (base64 encoded string)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="send-text" data-text="Sending text" tabindex="-1">Sending text</h3>

<p>Text can be sent using <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_realtime_input</code> (Python) or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">sendRealtimeInput</code> (JavaScript).</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_3" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Hello, how are you?"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_3" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">sendRealtimeInput</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Hello, how are you?'</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="send-video" data-text="Sending video" tabindex="-1">Sending video</h3>

<p>Video frames are sent as individual images (e.g., JPEG or PNG) at a specific frame rate (max 1 frame per second).</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_4" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Assuming 'frame' is your JPEG-encoded image bytes</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Blob</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">frame</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">mime_type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"image/jpeg"</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">frame</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">toString</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'base64'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">),</span>

<h4 id="incremental-updates" data-text="Incremental content updates" tabindex="-1">Incremental content updates</h4>

<p>Use incremental updates to send text input, establish session context, or
restore session context. For short contexts you can send turn-by-turn
interactions to represent the exact sequence of events:</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> For <code translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_client_content</code> is only
supported for seeding initial context history. You must set
<a href="/api/live#HistoryConfig"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">initial_history_in_client_content</code></a> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code> in the
session config&#39;s <code translate="no" dir="ltr">history_config</code>. After the first model turn, use
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_realtime_input</code> with the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">text</code> field instead.</span></aside><div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">turns</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"role"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"user"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"parts"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"text"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"What is the capital of Germany?"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}]}]</span>

<p>For longer contexts it&#39;s recommended to provide a single message summary to free
up the context window for subsequent interactions. See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/live-session#session-resumption">Session Resumption</a> for another method for
loading session context.</p>

<h3 id="audio-transcription" data-text="Audio transcriptions" tabindex="-1">Audio transcriptions</h3>

<p>In addition to the model response, you can also receive transcriptions of
both the audio output and the audio input.</p>

<p>To enable transcription of the model&#39;s audio output, send
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">output_audio_transcription</code> in the setup config. The transcription language is
inferred from the model&#39;s response.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview"</span>

    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"response_modalities"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">def</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nf">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">message</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Hello? Gemini are you there?"</span>

        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_client_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">else</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Received inline data: %s\n'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">else</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> &amp;&amp; </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">inputTranscription</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">debug</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'Received input transcription: %s\n'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">inputTranscription</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">close</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">().</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">catch</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">((</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span>&gt;<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">error</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'got error'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">));</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="change-voice-and-language" data-text="Change voice and language" tabindex="-1">Change voice and language</h3>

<p><a href="#native-audio-output">Native audio output</a> models support any of the voices
available for our <a href="/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation#voices">Text-to-Speech (TTS)</a>
models. You can listen to all the voices in <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/app/live">AI Studio</a>.</p>

<p>To specify a voice, set the voice name within the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">speechConfig</code> object as part
of the session configuration:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_8" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"response_modalities"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"speech_config"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"voice_config"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"prebuilt_voice_config"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"voice_name"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Kore"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}}</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_8" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">responseModalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Modality</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">AUDIO</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">speechConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">voiceConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prebuiltVoiceConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">voiceName</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Kore"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">};</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div><aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> If you&#39;re using the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">generateContent</code> API, the set of available voices is
slightly different. See the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/speech-generation#voices">speech generation guide</a>
for <code translate="no" dir="ltr">generateContent</code> audio generation voices.</span></aside>
<p>The Live API supports <a href="#supported-languages">multiple languages</a>.
<a href="#native-audio-output">Native audio output</a> models automatically choose
the appropriate language and don&#39;t support explicitly setting the language
code.</p>

<h2 id="native-audio-output" data-text="Native audio capabilities" tabindex="-1">Native audio capabilities</h2>

<p>Our latest models feature <a href="/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview">native audio output</a>,
which provides natural, realistic-sounding speech and improved multilingual
performance. </p>

<h3 id="native-audio-output-thinking" data-text="Thinking" tabindex="-1">Thinking</h3>

<p>Gemini 3.1 models use <code translate="no" dir="ltr">thinkingLevel</code> to control thinking depth, with settings
like <code translate="no" dir="ltr">minimal</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">low</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">medium</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">high</code>. The default is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">minimal</code> to
optimize for lowest latency. Gemini 2.5 models use
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">thinkingBudget</code> to set the number of thinking tokens instead. For more details
on levels vs budgets, see
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/thinking#levels-budgets">Thinking levels and budgets</a>.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_9" data-text=" Python " tabindex="-1"> Python </h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview"</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">LiveConnectConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response_modalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">thinking_config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">ThinkingConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">thinking_level</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"low"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send audio input and receive audio</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_9" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">responseModalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Modality</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">AUDIO</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">thinkingConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">thinkingLevel</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'low'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">};</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">callbacks</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">...,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Send audio input and receive audio</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">close</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p>Additionally, you can enable thought summaries by setting <code translate="no" dir="ltr">includeThoughts</code> to
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code> in your configuration. See <a href="/gemini-api/docs/thinking#summaries">thought summaries</a>
for more info:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_10" data-text=" Python " tabindex="-1"> Python </h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview"</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">LiveConnectConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response_modalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">thinking_config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">ThinkingConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">thinking_level</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"low"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">include_thoughts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_10" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">responseModalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Modality</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">AUDIO</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">thinkingConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">thinkingLevel</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'low'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">includeThoughts</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">true</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">};</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="affective-dialog" data-text="Affective dialog" tabindex="-1">Affective dialog</h3>

<p>This feature lets Gemini adapt its response style to the input expression and
tone.</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> This feature is not supported in Gemini 3.1 Flash Live.</span></aside>
<p>To use affective dialog, set the api version to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1beta</code> and set
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">enable_affective_dialog</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code>in the setup message:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_11" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">http_options</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"api_version"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"v1beta"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">})</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">LiveConnectConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response_modalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">enable_affective_dialog</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<h3 id="proactive-audio" data-text="Proactive audio" tabindex="-1">Proactive audio</h3>

<p>When this feature is enabled, Gemini can proactively decide not to respond
if the content is not relevant.</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> This feature is not supported in Gemini 3.1 Flash Live.</span></aside>
<p>To use it, set the api version to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">v1beta</code> and configure the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">proactivity</code>
field in the setup message and set <code translate="no" dir="ltr">proactive_audio</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code>:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_12" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">http_options</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"api_version"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"v1beta"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">})</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">LiveConnectConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response_modalities</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">proactivity</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'proactive_audio'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<h2 id="live-translate" data-text="Live translation" tabindex="-1">Live translation</h2>

<p>The Live API supports real-time, low-latency translation of spoken conversations. This capability lets you build real-time voice-to-voice translation applications.</p>

<p>For more information and examples, see the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/live-api/live-translate">Live Translation guide</a>.</p>

<h2 id="interruptions" data-text="Voice Activity Detection (VAD)" tabindex="-1">Voice Activity Detection (VAD)</h2>

<p>Voice Activity Detection (VAD) allows the model to recognize when a person is
speaking. This is essential for creating natural conversations, as it allows a
user to interrupt the model at any time.</p>

<p>When VAD detects an interruption, the ongoing generation is canceled and
discarded. Only the information already sent to the client is retained in the
session history. The server then sends a <a href="/api/live#bidigeneratecontentservercontent"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentServerContent</code></a> message to report the interruption.</p>

<p>The Gemini server then discards any pending function calls and sends a
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">BidiGenerateContentServerContent</code> message with the IDs of the canceled calls.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_13" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">in</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">receive</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">server_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">interrupted</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">is</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># The generation was interrupted</span>

        <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># If realtime playback is implemented in your application,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># you should stop playing audio and clear queued playback here.</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_13" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turns</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">handleTurn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">of</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turns</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> &amp;&amp; </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">turn</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">serverContent</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">interrupted</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// If realtime playback is implemented in your application,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// you should stop playing audio and clear queued playback here.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h3 id="use-automatic-vad" class="hide-from-toc" data-text="Automatic VAD" tabindex="-1">Automatic VAD</h3>

<p>By default, the model automatically performs VAD on
a continuous audio input stream. VAD can be configured with the
<a href="/api/live#RealtimeInputConfig.AutomaticActivityDetection"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection</code></a>
field of the <a href="/api/live#BidiGenerateContentSetup">setup configuration</a>.</p>

<p>When the audio stream is paused for more than a second (for example,
because the user switched off the microphone), an
<a href="/api/live#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.audio_stream_end"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">audioStreamEnd</code></a>
event should be sent to flush any cached audio. The client can resume sending
audio data at any time.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">pathlib</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">Path</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>

<p>With <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_realtime_input</code>, the API will respond to audio automatically based
on VAD. While <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_client_content</code> adds messages to the model context in
order, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">send_realtime_input</code> is optimized for responsiveness at the expense of
deterministic ordering.</p>

<h3 id="configure-automatic-vad" class="hide-from-toc" data-text="Automatic VAD configuration" tabindex="-1">Automatic VAD configuration</h3>

<p>For more control over the VAD activity, you can configure the following
parameters. See <a href="/api/live#automaticactivitydetection">API reference</a> for more
info.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_15" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google.genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"response_modalities"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"realtime_input_config"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"automatic_activity_detection"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"disabled"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-kc">False</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># default</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"start_of_speech_sensitivity"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">StartSensitivity</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">START_SENSITIVITY_LOW</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"end_of_speech_sensitivity"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">EndSensitivity</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">END_SENSITIVITY_LOW</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"prefix_padding_ms"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">20</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"silence_duration_ms"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">100</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<h3 id="hybrid-vad" class="hide-from-toc" data-text="Hybrid VAD" tabindex="-1">Hybrid VAD</h3>

<p>Hybrid VAD combines the benefits of automatic VAD (robust speech start detection) and manual VAD (low-latency response finalization).</p>

<p>In this configuration:</p>

<ol>
<li><strong>Automatic VAD remains enabled</strong> on the server. The server automatically
detects the start of user speech, using prefix padding to avoid clipping
the beginning of utterances.</li>
<li>The client uses a <strong>client-side VAD</strong> to detect when the user stops
speaking.</li>
<li>When the client-side VAD detects the end of speech, it sends an
<a href="/api/live#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.bool.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.audio_stream_end"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">audio_stream_end</code></a>
signal to the server.</li>
<li>The server treats the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">audio_stream_end</code> signal as an immediate
finalization prompt, bypassing the default server-side silence detection
delay and returning the transcript and model response with minimal latency.</li>
<li>If the client-side VAD fails to trigger, the server-side VAD acts as a
fallback to detect the end of speech.</li>
</ol>

<p>Note that if the client-side VAD threshold is set too aggressively, it may cause
speech cutoffs. However, this approach prevents front-truncation issues which
might occur with manual VAD.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_16" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Set up with automatic VAD enabled (default)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"response_modalities"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"AUDIO"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">with</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">aio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">live</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">connect</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send audio data normally</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Blob</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio_bytes</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">mime_type</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"audio/pcm;rate=16000"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># When client-side VAD detects the end of speech, send:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">session</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">send_realtime_input</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">audio_stream_end</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_16" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Set up with automatic VAD enabled (default)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<h3 id="disable-automatic-vad" class="hide-from-toc" data-text="Disable automatic VAD" tabindex="-1">Disable automatic VAD</h3>

<p>Alternatively, the automatic VAD can be disabled by setting
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection.disabled</code> to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">true</code> in the setup
message. In this configuration the client is responsible for detecting user
speech and sending
<a href="/api/live#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityStart.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.activity_start"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityStart</code></a>
and <a href="/api/live#BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.FIELDS.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.ActivityEnd.BidiGenerateContentRealtimeInput.activity_end"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityEnd</code></a>
messages at the appropriate times. An <code translate="no" dir="ltr">audioStreamEnd</code> isn&#39;t sent in
this configuration. Instead, any interruption of the stream is marked by
an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">activityEnd</code> message.</p>
